pricing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about pricing

faq.q1: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a1: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes are prorated and reflected in your next billing cycle.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: For EU customers (including Cyprus), we accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe, in EUR. SEPA Direct Debit is available on annual plans.
faq.q3: What happens to unused AI credits?
faq.a3: AI credits reset monthly on your billing date. Professional includes 500 credits/month; Enterprise is unlimited.
faq.a4: You can cancel any time. Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period, then moves to the free plan.
faq.q5: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
faq.a5: Yes — contact sales for annual billing with up to 20% savings.
